tokens.name: system-red
tokens.usage: Destructive actions, errors, critical status. Never decorative.

tokens.name: system-orange
tokens.usage: Warnings and attention states.

tokens.name: system-yellow
tokens.usage: Highlights and caution; never as text on light backgrounds (low contrast).

tokens.name: system-green
tokens.usage: Success, availability, and the 'on' state of toggles.

tokens.name: system-mint
tokens.usage: Secondary accent for categories and charts.

tokens.name: system-teal
tokens.usage: Secondary accent for categories and charts.

tokens.name: system-cyan
tokens.usage: Secondary accent for categories and charts.

tokens.name: system-blue
tokens.usage: Default app tint: links, tappable text, prominent buttons, selection. As text it is below 4.5:1 on white/black at 17pt regular (Apple's value kept exact) — use semibold or larger for long runs.

tokens.name: system-indigo
tokens.usage: Secondary accent for categories and charts.

tokens.name: system-purple
tokens.usage: Secondary accent for categories and charts.

tokens.name: system-pink
tokens.usage: Secondary accent for categories and charts.

tokens.name: system-brown
tokens.usage: Secondary accent for categories and charts.

tokens.name: system-gray
tokens.usage: Neutral glyphs, inactive icons, chart baselines.

tokens.name: system-gray-2
tokens.usage: Opaque neutral step 2 (higher = closer to the background). iOS-only in Apple's API; macOS themes reuse the iOS values.

tokens.name: system-gray-3
tokens.usage: Opaque neutral step 3 (higher = closer to the background). iOS-only in Apple's API; macOS themes reuse the iOS values.

tokens.name: system-gray-4
tokens.usage: Opaque neutral step 4 (higher = closer to the background). iOS-only in Apple's API; macOS themes reuse the iOS values.

tokens.name: system-gray-5
tokens.usage: Opaque neutral step 5 (higher = closer to the background). iOS-only in Apple's API; macOS themes reuse the iOS values.

tokens.name: system-gray-6
tokens.usage: Opaque neutral step 6 (higher = closer to the background). iOS-only in Apple's API; macOS themes reuse the iOS values.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Primary text on any background token.

tokens.name: label-secondary
tokens.usage: Subtitles, supporting text, values in list rows.

tokens.name: label-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholder text and disabled labels. Below 4.5:1 by design — never for essential text.

tokens.name: label-quaternary
tokens.usage: Watermarks and disabled glyphs only.

tokens.name: label-quinary
tokens.usage: Faintest text layer; decorative only.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Thin, small shapes: slider tracks, toggle off-track (macOS).

tokens.name: fill-secondary
tokens.usage: Medium shapes: macOS bordered buttons, toggle tracks.

tokens.name: fill-tertiary
tokens.usage: Large shapes: iOS bordered buttons, search fields, segmented control tracks.

tokens.name: fill-quaternary
tokens.usage: Very large areas: disabled prominent buttons, grouped content wells.

tokens.name: fill-quinary
tokens.usage: Faintest fill; hover tint on macOS rows.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairlines between list rows and sections (0.5pt on iOS, 1px on macOS). macOS dark has no separator swatch in the kit; it uses the dark quaternary label value (white 10%).

tokens.name: separator-opaque
tokens.usage: Separators that must hide content beneath them. iOS-only in Apple's API; macOS themes reuse the iOS values.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Main screen/window background for plain (non-grouped) content. macOS has a single window background; all three steps map to it on macOS.

tokens.name: background-secondary
tokens.usage: Content layered on background: cards, inset areas. macOS has a single window background; all three steps map to it on macOS.

tokens.name: background-tertiary
tokens.usage: Content layered on background-secondary. macOS has a single window background; all three steps map to it on macOS.

tokens.name: background-grouped
tokens.usage: Screen background behind grouped (inset) lists, e.g. Settings. macOS has no grouped background; maps to the window background.

tokens.name: background-grouped-secondary
tokens.usage: Cell background inside grouped lists. macOS has no grouped background; maps to the window background.

tokens.name: background-grouped-tertiary
tokens.usage: Content inside a grouped cell. macOS has no grouped background; maps to the window background.

tokens.name: background-elevated
tokens.usage: Backgrounds of sheets, popovers and modal surfaces in dark mode (iOS lifts them). Light mode equals the base background. macOS uses the panel color (Panels/Light, Panels/Dark).

tokens.name: background-elevated-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary layer inside an elevated surface. Light mode equals the base background. macOS uses the panel color (Panels/Light, Panels/Dark).

tokens.name: background-elevated-tertiary
tokens.usage: Tertiary layer inside an elevated surface. Light mode equals the base background. macOS uses the panel color (Panels/Light, Panels/Dark).

tokens.name: sidebar-background
tokens.usage: Sidebar column. macOS values are the active-window sidebar layer styles (translucent over the desktop); iOS uses the grouped background.

tokens.name: glass-label
tokens.usage: Primary text and glyphs on Liquid Glass controls (tab bars, toolbars, glass buttons). macOS uses the vibrant label values.

tokens.name: glass-label-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text on Liquid Glass. macOS uses the vibrant label values.

tokens.name: glass-label-tertiary
tokens.usage: Disabled text on Liquid Glass. macOS uses the vibrant label values.

tokens.name: glass-label-quaternary
tokens.usage: Faintest text on Liquid Glass. macOS uses the vibrant label values.

tokens.name: material-ultra-thick
tokens.usage: Ultra Thick translucent material tint; pair with backdrop-filter: blur(30px) saturate(180%). Values from the macOS kit's material layer styles, used on both platforms.

tokens.name: material-thick
tokens.usage: Thick translucent material tint; pair with backdrop-filter: blur(30px) saturate(180%). Values from the macOS kit's material layer styles, used on both platforms.

tokens.name: material-regular
tokens.usage: Regular translucent material tint; pair with backdrop-filter: blur(30px) saturate(180%). Values from the macOS kit's material layer styles, used on both platforms.

tokens.name: material-thin
tokens.usage: Thin translucent material tint; pair with backdrop-filter: blur(30px) saturate(180%). Values from the macOS kit's material layer styles, used on both platforms.

tokens.name: material-ultra-thin
tokens.usage: Ultra Thin translucent material tint; pair with backdrop-filter: blur(30px) saturate(180%). Values from the macOS kit's material layer styles, used on both platforms.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Liquid Glass surface tint for floating bars and large glass controls (Liquid Glass/Regular - Large/Medium). Pair with backdrop-filter blur and the glass shadow.

tokens.name: menu-fill
tokens.usage: Menu and context-menu glass tint (Liquid Glass/Menus).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: App tint. Override this one token to rebrand a project; every component reads it.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent for links and tappable text at body size and smaller. Light: Apple's web link blue (#0066cc, 5.6:1 on white); dark: system-blue. Rebrand it together with accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on accent fills. White on system-blue is ~3.6:1 (Apple's pairing, kept exact); fine for button labels 17pt+ / 13pt medium on macOS controls.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons and menu items.

tokens.name: toggle-on
tokens.usage: Track of a toggle that is on (green on iOS, accent on macOS).

tokens.name: control-knob
tokens.usage: Toggle and slider knobs.

tokens.name: button-bordered-fill
tokens.usage: Background of a bordered (gray) button. Exact per-platform values from the kits' Bordered button symbols.

tokens.name: button-disabled-fill
tokens.usage: Background of a disabled bordered or prominent button.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px outline, offset 1px. iOS uses the solid accent; macOS uses the accent at 50% as in AppKit.

tokens.name: progress-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled track of a progress bar. iOS: Fills/1 Primary (Table View Row); macOS: Linear track fill.

tokens.name: progress-track-border
tokens.usage: 0.5px inner border of a macOS progress track (Linear border); none on iOS.

tokens.name: segmented-thumb
tokens.usage: Selected-segment thumb of the iOS segmented control (Segmented Controls/Selected: white; white 27% in dark). macOS uses accent instead.

tokens.name: slider-knob
tokens.usage: Slider knob fill (Sliders/Knob/3 Rg/Idle: white; #DEDEDE in macOS dark).

tokens.name: window-control-close
tokens.usage: macOS Close traffic light (Window Controls/Standard/Active). Not shown on iOS.

tokens.name: window-control-minimize
tokens.usage: macOS Minimize traffic light (Window Controls/Standard/Active). Not shown on iOS.

tokens.name: window-control-zoom
tokens.usage: macOS Zoom/full-screen traffic light (Window Controls/Standard/Active). Not shown on iOS.

tokens.name: overlay-dim
tokens.usage: Scrim behind alerts, sheets and menus (Alerts/Overlay, Menus/Overlay; macOS Alerts/Window Modal Overlay).

tokens.name: menu-highlight
tokens.usage: macOS menu row hover/selection fill (Menus/Regular/Items/2 - Hover). iOS menus use fill-tertiary.

tokens.name: window-control-inactive
tokens.usage: Traffic lights in an inactive macOS window (Window Controls/Standard/Inactive).

tokens.name: sidebar-background-inactive
tokens.usage: Sidebar column of an inactive window (Sidebar/Background/Inactive). iOS repeats sidebar-background.

tokens.name: window-border
tokens.usage: 1px inner rim of an active dark-mode macOS window (Windows/Dark/Active border).

tokens.name: tooltip-fill
tokens.usage: Tooltip background (Tooltips/Light #E7E7E7 85%, Tooltips/Dark #262626 80%).

tokens.name: tooltip-label
tokens.usage: Tooltip text (Tooltips/Light #4C4C4C; Dark vibrant primary label 96%).

tokens.name: tooltip-border
tokens.usage: 0.6px inner ring of a dark-mode tooltip (Tooltips/Dark); none in light.

spacing.note: Values observed in the kits' control paddings and layout margins.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inset of a toggle knob and segmented-control thumb inside its track.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between a symbol and its label inside a button; macOS button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of iOS medium buttons; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of iOS small and macOS small buttons; menu inner padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of iOS medium buttons.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Inner padding of alerts and action sheets.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: iOS screen side margin and list inset; macOS button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of iOS large buttons; macOS window content margin; iOS margin on wide layouts.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Separation between groups of content.

tokens.name: radius-mini
tokens.usage: macOS mini controls.

tokens.name: radius-small
tokens.usage: macOS small controls.

tokens.name: radius-regular
tokens.usage: macOS regular buttons, fields and pop-ups.

tokens.name: radius-grouped
tokens.usage: iOS grouped (inset) list sections.

tokens.name: radius-menu
tokens.usage: iOS menus and context menus.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: iOS alerts, action sheets and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Capsules: every iOS button, toggle, segmented control, search field; macOS large/XL buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Floating Liquid Glass surfaces: alerts, menus, sheets, popovers (the kit's main drop shadow).

tokens.name: shadow-glass-control
tokens.usage: Glass buttons and other small glass controls.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: Active macOS window (Windows/Active).

tokens.name: shadow-window-inactive
tokens.usage: Inactive macOS window (Windows/Inactive).

tokens.name: shadow-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltip drop shadow (Tooltips/*).

tokens.name: shadow-knob
tokens.usage: Toggle and slider knobs.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on iOS (HIG). Rows, toolbar buttons and tab items never go smaller.

tokens.name: control-ios-small
tokens.usage: Height of small iOS buttons and toggles.

tokens.name: control-ios-medium
tokens.usage: Height of medium iOS buttons and glass buttons.

tokens.name: control-ios-large
tokens.usage: Height of large iOS buttons.

tokens.name: control-macos-small
tokens.usage: Height of small macOS controls.

tokens.name: control-macos-regular
tokens.usage: Height of regular macOS buttons, fields and pop-ups.

tokens.name: control-macos-large
tokens.usage: Height of large macOS controls.

tokens.name: row-ios
tokens.usage: Default iOS list row height (single line with 17pt text in iOS 27).

tokens.name: separator-width
tokens.usage: Hairline thickness on iOS; use 1px on macOS.

tokens.name: readable-width
tokens.usage: Maximum width of long reading text (Apple's readable content width). Center the column on iPad, Mac and iPhone in landscape.
